entries.description: Task 1a.1: baseline evidence before the layout move
steps: record uv run python scripts/check_wheels.py output
record scripts/plugin_inventory.py hashes for domain-erp and odoo19 built from fresh wheels
list the files of all 10 built wheels with unzip -l as the must-be-identical reference

entries.description: Task 1a.2: mover script and the code move into src/e_agent with dists/<name>/pyproject.toml
steps: tests/conformance/test_repo_layout.py asserts: no packages/ or apps/ directory, every dists/*/pyproject.toml force-include source exists, no src/e_agent/__init__.py
test_repo_layout.py is marked xfail(strict=True) and xfails on the pre-move tree (the move itself runs in 1a.3)
tests/conformance/test_repo_move.py proves layout, links and check on a scratch git repository

entries.description: Task 1a.3: run the layout move, update tooling and path references (one commit)
steps: repo_move.py layout run; test_repo_layout.py passes without xfail
repo_move.py check reports no broken links and no stale old-path references in code or config
uv lock changes only source paths

the wheel reference regenerated from the new wheels (command in docs/handoffs/2026-10-13-phase1-1a1-baseline.md) diffs clean against docs/handoffs/2026-10-13-phase1-1a1-wheel-reference.txt, except explained .dist-info backend noise
plugin_inventory.py manifest_sha256 and artifact_sha256 for domain-erp and odoo19 equal the 1a.1 baseline
.vscode/settings.json excludes __pycache__, .mypy_cache, .ruff_cache, .pytest_cache, .import_linter_cache, ui/**/node_modules and ui/**/dist in files.exclude and search.exclude
repo_move.py links --move of the nine design docs to docs/design

entries.description: Task 1b.2: plans and specs moved out of docs/superpowers/
steps: active plans are in docs/plans/ and specs in docs/specs/
the roadmap Rules plan-location sentence is updated

entries.description: Task 1b.3: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and README rewritten for the new layout and roadmap rules
Task 1b.4: target-architecture section 15 tree and section 16 locations updated
steps: section 15 shows the new layout marked [I] with a rationale linking the Phase 1 plan
section 16 Location today paths use the new layout
uv run python scripts/repo_move.py check --docs reports 0 old paths in current docs (mvp-detailed-design layout table included)

entries.description: Task 1c.1: pin the coordinator public surface in tests/unit/kernel/test_structure.py
steps: every name imported from e_agent.kernel.coordinator by tests, scripts and the server is importable
the listed public RunCoordinator methods exist
the test passes on the unsplit code

Task 1c.8: dispatch.py, verification.py and recovery.py mixins moved verbatim
